summary: Iteration 43 backend + frontend testing complete. 21/21 backend pytest cases green across Super, Temperature, and Table-Courses. Frontend: Products KPI strip, /marketing hub (9 tabs), 6 legacy redirects, /super KPI+calc+commit selectors, /temperature page + KPI + period tabs, and /floor-plan drawer (seat → advance course → send nudge → course settings dialog) all rendered and interactive. All test-ids the spec called out for the FloorPlan drawer + Marketing + Products + Super pages are present; a few Temperature.jsx button test-ids use short names (add-device / refresh-temperature / scan-missing / log-reading / run-report / export-csv) instead of the *-btn names the spec listed — buttons work, only the selector aliases differ.

ui_bugs.issue: Button data-testids differ from spec: uses 'add-device', 'refresh-temperature', 'scan-missing', 'log-reading', 'run-report', 'export-csv' instead of the '*-btn' variants (add-device-btn, register-device-btn, log-reading-btn, refresh-btn, scan-missing-btn, generate-btn, export-csv-btn). Functionality intact — pure test-id alias mismatch. There is also no separate 'register-device-btn'; the Add-device dialog itself surfaces the ingestSecret on save (verified server-side).
SVG table nodes use data-testid='floor-table-{id}' rather than 'table-{id}' that the review request mentioned. Drawer test-id 'seat-table' is used (spec said 'seat-table-btn').

issues: Multiple 404 console errors on every page load (static asset misses) — cosmetic but noisy in devtools.

action_items: OPTIONAL: rename Temperature.jsx button test-ids to the '*-btn' aliases the spec called out (add-device-btn, refresh-btn, scan-missing-btn, log-reading-btn, run-report → generate-btn, export-csv → export-csv-btn) OR update the spec to match what shipped.
OPTIONAL: alias FloorPlan table test-id to 'table-{id}' and drawer seat button to 'seat-table-btn' for spec parity.
Investigate the recurring static-asset 404s in the browser console (non-blocking).
critical_code_review_comments: super.py, temperature.py, table_courses.py all cleanly strip MongoDB _id, use env-driven config, and gate write endpoints by role — no findings.
temperature.py email path is safely no-op when TEMP_ALERT_EMAIL/OWNER_EMAIL or utilities.email_sender are absent (documented + covered in code).
Weekly-run PATCH validates status ∈ {unpaid, paid, reversed} and BAS-line correctly computes 28-day reporting-due window (verified: 2025-09-30 → 2025-10-28).

success_rate.frontend: ~95% (all critical flows verified, minor test-id alias mismatches only)

seed_data_creation: Created TEST_ prefixed super weekly-runs, temperature devices/readings/alerts, and table_states — cleaned up (device deleted; table state cleared implicitly by clearState=true path).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Iter 43 shipped 3 new backend routers (super, temperature, table_courses) + 4 new frontend pages (Marketing hub, Super, Temperature, ItemsKpiStrip + TableInfoDrawer). All backend endpoints in the spec verified via /app/backend/tests/test_iteration43_batch.py. Front-end verified via login → /products (KPI strip toggles filter), /marketing (all 9 tabs + URL sync), 6 legacy redirects (social-media, discounts, loyalty, booking-experience, clubmember, email-marketing), /super (KPIs, calculator selectors), /temperature (KPIs + period toggles + device card rendering), /floor-plan (SVG table click → drawer → seat → course advance → send-nudge → open course settings dialog with save). Only cosmetic delta: Temperature buttons use short test-ids (add-device / refresh-temperature / scan-missing / log-reading / run-report / export-csv) — the spec listed *-btn variants; ditto floor-plan tables use 'floor-table-{id}' vs spec's 'table-{id}'.
rca of the issue: N/A — no failures. The two test-id alias mismatches are naming choices by E1 that diverge from the review-request wording; they do not break UX or automation as long as tests use the actual selectors documented above.
